title: Crunchy Frozen Blueberry Yogurt Bark
excerpt: A sheet of frozen yogurt with blueberries and almonds that you break into pieces: a fresh, easy, no-bake dessert.
imageAlt: Pieces of frozen yogurt bark with fresh blueberries and sliced almonds on baking paper

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup sliced almonds or chopped walnuts

steps: Line a small tray with baking paper.
Mix the yogurt with the honey and vanilla.
Spread the mixture over the paper in a layer about 1 cm (1/2 in) thick.
Scatter the blueberries and almonds on top, pressing them in lightly.
Freeze for at least 3 hours and break into irregular pieces right before serving.
tips: Crush half of the blueberries with a fork before adding them: they create very eye-catching purple swirls.
Store it in the freezer in an airtight container, separating the layers with paper.
